messages:
peter (sales): Kicking off PhotonHealth perf check. Ask: can we sustain 180 qps gen endpoint for 25m with p95 < 280ms? They also worried about microburst spikes during insurance claim windows.
anya (eng-sre): Plan: 8m ramp, 25m steady, open-loop. We'll run microburst probes (short 2m 600 qps bursts) during steady to exercise autoscaling and queueing. Route to dedicated-pool-b, model=redwood-v2-7b-q4f.
david (eng-platform): Note: enable prefix cache and continuous batching. We'll set autoscale cooldown to 45s for bursts.
claire (solutions): Important: Photon wants a simple blurb about worst-case tail and downstream retry guidance.
test-bot: run_id=ph-3276543210 | start=2025-12-07T09:12:30Z | profile=8m-ramp-25m-steady+bursts | qps_base=180 | burst=600
anya (eng-sre): Local run command:
```
burstload --url https://api.redwood.test/v1/gen --open-loop \
  --ramp 8m --steady 25m --qps 180 --burst 600:2m:every10m \
  --concurrency 1800 --payload ./ph_prompts.json
```
anya (eng-sre): Snapshot @ +10m (before first burst): p50=40ms p95=210ms p99=680ms errs=0.2% GPU util 74% cache hit 59%.
peter (sales): Good. Run first microburst now.
test-bot: action=burst-start | target=dedicated-pool-b | burst_qps=600 | duration=120s | ts=2025-12-07T09:25:00Z
anya (eng-sre): During burst: p50=52ms p95=410ms p99=1.35s errors rose to 0.9% (mostly 429/503 during scale-up). Queue depth spiked briefly. Autoscale added instances ~35s into burst.
david (eng-platform): Observed efficient scale but cache miss increased (hit -> 33%) causing extra token overhead. Suggest pre-warm before expected claim windows.
claire (solutions): For the Photon note: recommend client retry with jitter and idempotency keys; set 2s initial backoff for 429s.
peter (sales): Can we quantify cost delta during bursts? Back-of-envelope for a 2m burst at 600 qps.
anya (eng-sre): Estimate: burst added ~0.15 GPU-hours across run -> infra delta ~$2.5. Token-level inefficiency ~+22% when cache cold.
david (eng-platform): After bursts settled, metrics returned: p95 baseline back to 220ms within ~90s. No persistent errors.
test-bot: run_complete | end=2025-12-07T09:37:40Z | artifacts=/runs/ph-3276543210/{graphs,logs}

anya (eng-sre): Final: steady p95=215ms overall, during bursts p95 peaked ~410ms transiently, p99 up to 1.35s. Availability >99.95%. Recommend pre-warm standby and autoscale cooldown tuning for tight windows.
claire (solutions): I'll draft the one-pager: executive summary, burst behavior, retry guidance, cost delta table, and recommended SLA language.
peter (sales): Thanks team. I'll send sanitized graphs to PhotonHealth and propose a 30m technical review. End thread.
